note.tr: YAZILMADI, ÜRETİLDİ. Buradaki her şekil, külliyatın hâlihazırda taşıdığı bir kök yahut lemmadan hareketle uygulamanın kendi kat'î motorlarınca hesaplanmıştır. Bir motor değişikliği tek bir hâneyi oynattığında adı belli bir madde üzerinde fark olarak görünsün diye depoya işlenir. Bu bir metin değildir, ilmî bir eser hiç değildir: motorların davranışının yazıya geçirilmiş hâlidir.

why.ar: الِاسْمُ الْمَقْصُورُ تُقَدَّرُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَرَكَاتُ الثَّلَاثُ لِلتَّعَذُّرِ وَيُكْتَبُ تَنْوِينُهُ فَتْحَةً قَبْلَ الْأَلِفِ فِي الْأَحْوَالِ الثَّلَاثَةِ

why.tr: İSM-İ MAKSÛRun sonu hareke taşıyamayan eliftir; üç i'râb da onun üzerinde TAKDÎR edilir, hiçbiri yazılmaz. Tenvîni üç hâlde de elifin öncesine FETHATAN olarak yazılır — فَتًى, fâil de olsa mef'ûl de olsa cer harfinden sonra da olsa aynı yazılır → فَتًى

why.ar: مَمْدُودٌ هَمْزَتُهُ مُنْقَلِبَةٌ عَنْ أَصْلٍ — فَهُوَ مُنْصَرِفٌ نَكِرَةٌ مُنْصَرِفَةٌ — تَأْخُذُ التَّنْوِينَ عَلَى حَرَكَةِ مَوْقِعِهَا

why.tr: CEM'-İ MÜENNES-İ SÂLİM nasb hâlinde fetha yerine KESRA alır — mansub bir ismin fetha ile yazılmadığı tek yer → الطَّالِبَاتِ

why.ar: جَمْعُ الْمُؤَنَّثِ السَّالِمُ يُرْفَعُ بِالضَّمَّةِ وَيُجَرُّ بِالْكَسْرَةِ
why.en: a sound feminine plural takes the damma in raf' and the kasra in jarr → الطَّالِبَاتِ
why.tr: Cem'-i müennes-i sâlim ref'de damme, cerde kesra alır → الطَّالِبَاتِ

why.ar: مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْخَمْسَةِ — تُعْرَبُ بِالْحُرُوفِ عِنْدَ الْإِضَافَةِ
why.en: one of the FIVE NOUNS, and a mudaf: it declines by a LETTER — waw, alif, ya → أَبُو
why.tr: ESMÂ-İ HAMSEden ve muzâf: HARF ile i'râb alır — vâv, elif, yâ → أَبُو

why.ar: الْمَنْقُوصُ النَّكِرَةُ تُحْذَفُ يَاؤُهُ رَفْعًا وَجَرًّا وَيُعَوَّضُ عَنْهَا بِالتَّنْوِينِ
why.en: an INDEFINITE manqus drops its ya in raf' and in jarr and puts a tanwin in its place — قَاضٍ — and keeps it in nasb, where the fatha can be written: قَاضِيًا → دَاعٍ
why.tr: NEKRE MENKŪSun yâsı ref' ve cerde düşer, yerine tenvîn gelir — قَاضٍ — nasbda ise fetha yazılabildiği için yâ kalır: قَاضِيًا → دَاعٍ

why.ar: هَذَا مَنْقُوصٌ مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ — وَهُوَ أَدَقُّ مَا فِي الْبَابِ وَفِي الرَّفْعِ وَالْجَرِّ تُحْذَفُ يَاؤُهُ وَيُعَوَّضُ عَنْهَا بِالتَّنْوِينِ — تَنْوِينُ عِوَضٍ لَا تَنْوِينُ تَمْكِينٍ
why.en: this word is a MANQUS and BARRED FROM TANWIN at once — the hardest row in the table in raf' and in jarr the ya is DROPPED and a tanwin stands in its place — a tanwin of COMPENSATION, not the tanwin of the indefinite. That is how a word barred from tanwin comes to be written with one → جَوَارٍ
why.tr: Bu kelime hem MENKŪS hem GAYR-İ MUNSARİFtir — bâbın en ince yeri. Ref' ve cerde yâsı DÜŞER, yerine tenvîn getirilir — temkin tenvîni değil İVAZ tenvîni. Tenvînden men edilmiş bir kelimenin tenvînle yazılmasının sebebi budur → جَوَارٍ

why.ar: هَذَا مَنْقُوصٌ مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ — وَهُوَ أَدَقُّ مَا فِي الْبَابِ فَفِي النَّصْبِ تَعُودُ يَاؤُهُ وَتَظْهَرُ الْفَتْحَةُ بِلَا تَنْوِينٍ
why.en: this word is a MANQUS and BARRED FROM TANWIN at once — the hardest row in the table in nasb its ya comes back and the fatha is written BARE — no tanwin, because the word is barred from it → جَوَارِيَ
why.tr: Bu kelime hem MENKŪS hem GAYR-İ MUNSARİFtir — bâbın en ince yeri. Nasbda yâsı geri döner ve fetha TENVÎNSİZ yazılır; zira kelime tenvînden men edilmiştir → جَوَارِيَ

why.ar: الِاسْمُ الْمَقْصُورُ تُقَدَّرُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَرَكَاتُ الثَّلَاثُ لِلتَّعَذُّرِ وَيُكْتَبُ تَنْوِينُهُ فَتْحَةً قَبْلَ الْأَلِفِ فِي الْأَحْوَالِ الثَّلَاثَةِ
why.en: a MAQSUR noun ends in an alif that cannot carry a vowel, so all three cases are UNDERSTOOD on it and none is written and its tanwin is written as a FATHATAN before the alif in all three cases alike — فَتًى is the same word whether it is the doer, the object or after a jarr letter → هُدًى
why.tr: İSM-İ MAKSÛRun sonu hareke taşıyamayan eliftir; üç i'râb da onun üzerinde TAKDÎR edilir, hiçbiri yazılmaz. Tenvîni üç hâlde de elifin öncesine FETHATAN olarak yazılır — فَتًى, fâil de olsa mef'ûl de olsa cer harfinden sonra da olsa aynı yazılır → هُدًى

why.ar: مَمْدُودٌ هَمْزَتُهُ مُنْقَلِبَةٌ عَنْ أَصْلٍ — فَهُوَ مُنْصَرِفٌ نَكِرَةٌ مُنْصَرِفَةٌ — تَأْخُذُ التَّنْوِينَ عَلَى حَرَكَةِ مَوْقِعِهَا
why.en: this is a MAMDUD noun too, but its hamza is the root's own last letter turned into one — so it is ORDINARY and keeps its tanwin. صَحْرَاءُ and خَفَاءً end in the same three letters and decline differently, and only the root says which is which indefinite and munsarif — it takes the tanwin of its own case → اِسْتِعْلَاءٌ
why.tr: Bu da MEMDÛD bir isimdir, fakat hemzesi kökün son harfinden dönüşmüştür — bu yüzden MUNSARİFtir ve tenvînini korur. صَحْرَاءُ ile خَفَاءً aynı üç harfle biter ve farklı i'râb alır; hangisinin hangisi olduğunu yalnız kök söyler. Nekre ve munsarif — kendi mevkiinin tenvînini alır → اِسْتِعْلَاءٌ

why.en: the TANWIN is dropped for the idafa — a mudaf is made definite by what follows it, and the tanwin is the mark of the indefinite → كِتَابُ the mudaf ilayh is in jarr by the kasra — already definite, so no tanwin → الْوَلَدِ

why.en: the TANWIN is dropped for the idafa — a mudaf is made definite by what follows it, and the tanwin is the mark of the indefinite → قِسْمَةُ the mudaf ilayh is BARRED FROM TANWIN, and such a noun takes a FATHA in jarr, not a kasra — unless it wears ال or is itself a mudaf → غَنَائِمَ
why.tr: İzâfet sebebiyle TENVÎN düşer — muzâf kendisinden sonrakiyle marife olur, tenvîn ise nekrelik alâmetidir → قِسْمَةُ Muzâfun ileyh GAYR-İ MUNSARİFtir; böyle bir isim cerde kesra değil FETHA alır — «أَلْ» almadıkça yahut kendisi muzâf olmadıkça → غَنَائِمَ

why.ar: لَا يَجْتَمِعُ الْأَلِفُ وَاللَّامُ وَالْإِضَافَةُ — فَلَا يَصِحُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ الْمُضَافُ مُعَرَّفًا بِـ«أَلْ».
why.en: The article and an idafa never combine. A noun is made definite EITHER by ال OR by what follows it — never by both — so «الْكِتَابُ» cannot be a mudaf while it wears ال. Drop the article and try again.
why.tr: Harf-i tarif ile izâfet bir arada bulunmaz. Bir isim YA «أَلْ» ile YA da kendisinden sonrakiyle marife olur, ikisiyle birden olmaz; öyleyse «الْكِتَابُ» «أَلْ» ile iken muzâf olamaz. Harf-i tarifi düşürüp tekrar deneyin.

paradigms.note: مُضَاعَفٌ مِنَ الْإِفْعَالِ: الْجَزْمُ بِالْفَتْحِ — لَمْ يُحِلَّ وَنَحْوُهُ.
مُضَاعَفٌ مِنَ الِانْفِعَالِ: الْجَزْمُ بِالْفَتْحِ، وَيَجُوزُ الْفَكُّ.
مِثَالٌ وَاوِيٌّ: تَسْقُطُ الْوَاوُ فِي الْمُضَارِعِ وَالْأَمْرِ.
مُضَاعَفٌ مِنَ الِانْفِعَالِ: الْجَزْمُ بِالْفَتْحِ، وَيَجُوزُ الْفَكُّ.
مُضَاعَفٌ مِنَ الْإِفْعَالِ: الْجَزْمُ بِالْفَتْحِ — لَمْ يُحِلَّ وَنَحْوُهُ.

sentences.text: أُصُولُ الْفِقْهِ وَهُوَ عِلْمٌ يُعْرَفُ بِهِ أَحْوَالُ الْأَدِلَّةِ وَالْأَحْكَامِ الشَّرْعِيَّتَيْنِ

translation.en: The principles of jurisprudence: a science by which the states of the two kinds of evidence and rulings are known.
translation.tr: Usûl-i fıkıh: şer'î delillerin ve hükümlerin hâllerinin kendisiyle bilindiği ilimdir.

human.irab: Mubtada in raf'; mudaf.
Mudaf ilayh in jarr.
The و opens a new clause; «huwa» is a detached pronoun, in the position of raf' as mubtada.
Khabar in raf' marked by damma.
Present verb in the PASSIVE, in raf'; the clause describes «a science».
Preposition ب with the pronoun in jarr.
The deputy subject (naib al-fail), in raf'; mudaf.
Mudaf ilayh in jarr.
The و joins; «the rulings» follows in jarr.
An adjective in jarr, marked by ي because it is dual — «the two Shar'i kinds».

sentences.text: الْأَصْلُ وَهُوَ مَا يُبْتَنَى عَلَيْهِ غَيْرُهُ

translation.en: The principle (asl): that upon which something else is built.
translation.tr: Asıl: kendisi üzerine başkasının bina edildiği şeydir.

human.irab: Mubtada in raf' marked by damma.
The و opens the clause; «huwa» is the mubtada.
Relative noun, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
Present verb in the PASSIVE, in raf' with an implied damma; the clause is the sila. Form VIII.
Preposition على with the pronoun in jarr.
The deputy subject, in raf'; mudaf, with ـه as mudaf ilayh.

sentences.text: الْفِقْهُ مَعْرِفَةُ النَّفْسِ مَا لَهَا وَمَا عَلَيْهَا عَمَلًا

translation.en: Jurisprudence: the soul's knowing what is for it and what is against it, in practice.
translation.tr: Fıkıh: nefsin lehinde ve aleyhinde olanı amel bakımından bilmesidir.

human.irab: Mubtada in raf'.
Khabar in raf'; mudaf.
Mudaf ilayh in jarr — and the doer of the knowing, in sense.
Relative noun, in the position of nasb as the object of the masdar «knowing».
Preposition ل with «ha» in jarr; the phrase is the sila.
The و joins; this «ma» is coupled to the first.
Preposition على with «ha» in jarr.
Tamyiz in nasb — it clears up in WHAT RESPECT the knowing is meant: in practice, not in belief. This one word is what distinguishes fiqh from kalam.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ الْأَدِلَّةُ أَرْبَعَةٌ الْكِتَابُ وَالسُّنَّةُ وَالْإِجْمَاعُ وَالْقِيَاسُ

translation.en: Then the sources are four: the Book, the Sunna, consensus and analogy.
translation.tr: Deliller dörttür: Kitâb, Sünnet, icmâ ve kıyâs.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ اسْتِئْنَافِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: An isti'naf nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval — with it the matn steps from defining its terms to its real subject.
The mubtada in raf' by the damma — the plural of «dalil» on أَفْعِلَة.
The khabar in raf' — and it wears the TA because what it counts is masculine: from three to ten the number takes the OPPOSITE gender to the thing counted.
A badal of «four», in raf' — a badal of DETAIL, which unpacks the summary before it.
Joined, in raf'.
Joined, in raf' — the masdar of أَجْمَعَ on إِفْعَال.
Joined, in raf' — the masdar of قَايَسَ, and with it the count of four is complete.

sentences.text: أَمَّا الْكِتَابُ فَهُوَ الْقُرْآنُ الْمَنْقُولُ إِلَيْنَا بَيْنَ دَفَّتَيِ الْمُصْحَفِ نَقْلًا مُتَوَاتِرًا

translation.en: As for the Book, it is the Qur'an transmitted to us between the two covers of the codex by a mass transmission.
translation.tr: Kitâb'a gelince, o bize mushafın iki kapağı arasında mütevâtir bir nakille nakledilen Kur'ân'dır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ وَقَعَتْ جَوَابًا لِـ«أَمَّا» — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause standing as «amma»'s answer — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of CONDITION, of DETAILING and of EMPHASIS at once, standing in for «whatever may be of the matter» — which is why its answer must carry the FA.
The mubtada in raf' — something must stand between «amma» and its fa, and this mubtada is that something: the very word being singled out.
The FA is the one that falls in «amma»'s answer, and «huwa» is either a separating pronoun or a second mubtada; the clause is the khabar of the first.
The khabar, in raf' by the damma.
A na't of «the Qur'an», in raf' — the ism maf'ul of نَقَلَ, and it GOVERNS like its verb, so what follows attaches to it.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «transmitted».
A place-adverb in nasb and a mudaf, attaching to «transmitted».
The mudaf ilayh, in jarr by the YA because it is a DUAL — and its NUN has fallen for the idafa, exactly where a tanwin would have fallen. The ya then takes a kasra because two sukuns met.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — in origin a tool-noun on مُفْعَل: the thing the pages are gathered in.
A MAF'UL MUTLAQ in nasb — the masdar that confirms its own governor «transmitted». Its presence is the proof that the participle really does govern.
A na't of «a transmission», in nasb — the ism fa'il of تَوَاتَرَ on مُتَفَاعِل: the transmission whose transmitters could not possibly have agreed on a lie.

sentences.text: وَأَمَّا السُّنَّةُ فَمَا صَدَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ أَوْ تَقْرِيرٍ

translation.en: And as for the Sunna, it is what issued from the Prophet by way of word, deed or tacit approval.
translation.tr: Sünnet'e gelince, o Peygamber'den söz, fiil yahut takrîr olarak sâdır olandır.

jumal.text: وَأَمَّا السُّنَّةُ فَمَا صَدَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ وَقَعَتْ جَوَابًا لِـ«أَمَّا» — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause standing as «amma»'s answer — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw and the detailing «amma» — with it the enumeration is carried on to its second item.
The mubtada in raf', and the thing standing between «amma» and its fa.
The fa of «amma»'s answer, and «ma» is a RELATIVE noun — fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb with a hidden «he» for its fa'il — and the clause is the SILA of the relative, which never has a position in i'rab.
A jarr letter of going-out-from, attaching to «issued» — its nun takes a kasra because two sukuns met.
In jarr after «an» by the kasra — فَعِيل in the sense of مَفْعُول on one reading: the one informed.
A jarr letter of EXPLAINING what a thing consists of; the phrase is a hal from the pronoun inside «issued».
In jarr after «min» — the masdar of قَالَ.
A letter of atf giving KINDS, not doubt: it lists the sorts of thing, it does not waver between them.
Joined to «word», in jarr.
Another atf of kinds.
Joined, in jarr — the masdar of قَرَّرَ on تَفْعِيل: his saying nothing about an act done in his presence, which is itself a ruling.

sentences.text: وَأَمَّا الْإِجْمَاعُ فَهُوَ اِتِّفَاقُ الْمُجْتَهِدِينَ مِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي عَصْرٍ عَلَى حُكْمٍ شَرْعِيٍّ

translation.en: And as for consensus, it is the agreement of the mujtahids of Muhammad's community, in one age, upon a legal ruling.
translation.tr: İcmâ'a gelince, o, Muhammed ümmetinin müctehidlerinin bir asırda şer'î bir hüküm üzerinde ittifâk etmesidir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ وَقَعَتْ جَوَابًا لِـ«أَمَّا» — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause standing as «amma»'s answer — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw and the detailing «amma» — this is the third item of the enumeration.
The mubtada in raf', and the thing standing between «amma» and its fa.
The FA of «amma»'s answer, and «huwa» a second mubtada; the clause is the khabar of the first.

The khabar in raf', and a mudaf — the masdar of اِتَّفَقَ on اِفْتِعَال. Its origin is اِوْتِفَاق from و ف ق: the WAW was turned into a ta and swallowed into the ta of the pattern. The doubled ta you see is two letters, only one of them original.
The mudaf ilayh, in jarr by the YA because it is a SOUND MASCULINE PLURAL — and its NUN has fallen for the idafa, exactly as the dual's nun fell in the chapter before. One law, two shapes.
A jarr letter of PART-OF; the phrase is a hal from «the mujtahids».
In jarr after «min», and itself a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — a proper name carried over from the ism maf'ul of حَمَّدَ: the one praised again and again.
A jarr letter of containment, attaching to «the agreement».
In jarr after «fi» — and it is left INDEFINITE on purpose: any one age, not the first age alone.
A jarr letter of resting-upon in the figurative sense, attaching to «the agreement» — this is the word that says WHAT they agreed on.
In jarr after «ala».
A na't of «a ruling», in jarr — a NISBA noun made with the ya of relation, and by it the rational and the sensory ruling are shut out.

sentences.text: وَأَمَّا الْقِيَاسُ فَهُوَ تَعْدِيَةُ الْحُكْمِ مِنَ الْأَصْلِ إِلَى الْفَرْعِ بِعِلَّةٍ جَامِعَةٍ

translation.en: And as for analogy, it is the carrying of the ruling from the root case to the branch case by a cause that gathers the two.
translation.tr: Kıyâs'a gelince, o, hükmü, iki tarafı toplayan bir illetle asıldan fer'e taşımaktır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ وَقَعَتْ جَوَابًا لِـ«أَمَّا» — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause standing as «amma»'s answer — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw and the detailing «amma» — the fourth and last item.
The mubtada in raf', and the separator.
The FA of «amma»'s answer, and «huwa» a second mubtada.

The khabar in raf', and a mudaf — the masdar of عَدَّى on تَفْعِيل. Because its LAM is weak, تَفْعِيل could not stand, so the TA MARBUTA came in to make good what the weak letter cost. Every Form II naqis masdar is built this way: تَزْكِيَة، تَسْمِيَة، تَعْدِيَة.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr by its FORM, but the masdar's OBJECT in meaning: the thing carried across is the ruling.
A jarr letter for the START of the span, attaching to «the carrying» — its nun takes a fatha because two sukuns met.
In jarr after «min» — the case measured AGAINST, the one the text actually spoke about.
A jarr letter for the END of the span, attaching to «the carrying» — with it both ends of the span are set.
In jarr after «ila» — the case measured, the one the text was silent about.
The BA of causation, and «a cause» in jarr after it — the property the ruling was hung upon.
A na't of «a cause», in jarr — the ism fa'il of جَمَعَ, and by it the CONFINED cause is shut out: a cause that never reaches past its own case cannot carry a ruling anywhere.

sentences.text: فَهَذِهِ هِيَ الْأُصُولُ الْأَرْبَعَةُ الَّتِي عَلَيْهَا مَدَارُ الْأَحْكَامِ

translation.en: So these are the four principles upon which the rulings turn.
translation.tr: İşte hükümlerin medârı olan dört asıl bunlardır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A «telling» fa — the one that answers a condition the words leave unsaid — and «hadhihi» a demonstrative, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as mubtada. The HA in front of it is the ha of drawing attention.

A PRONOUN OF SEPARATION, with no position in i'rab. It is brought for two reasons: so the reader knows what follows is the KHABAR and not another adjective, and to give restriction — these four and no others.
The khabar in raf' by the damma — the plural of «asl».
A na't in raf' — and it wears the TA because what it counts, «principles», is masculine, exactly as at the head of this section.

A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as a SECOND na't of «the principles» — and it comes in the feminine singular shape because a plural of non-rational things is treated as one feminine thing.
A jarr-majrur standing as the khabar, and standing FIRST. The fronting is the whole point: it is what makes the clause say «on these, and on nothing else.»
The mubtada, in raf' and coming LAST, and a mudaf — a place-noun from دَارَ: the point a thing turns about.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — and with it the section closes on what it opened with: four, and rulings that turn upon them.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ اللَّفْظُ أَرْبَعَةُ أَقْسَامٍ خَاصٌّ وَعَامٌّ وَمُشْتَرَكٌ وَمُؤَوَّلٌ

translation.en: Then the wording is of four kinds: the specific, the general, the shared and the interpreted.
translation.tr: Lafız dört kısımdır: hâss, âmm, müşterek ve müevvel.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ اسْتِئْنَافِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: An isti'naf nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval — with it the matn steps from naming the sources to dividing the wording of the first of them.
The mubtada in raf' by the damma — and what is meant is the wording SET DOWN for a meaning, not mere sound.

The khabar in raf', and a MUDAF — from three to ten the number is joined to what it counts by an IDAFA, not by a mansub tamyiz. Note the contrast with chapter 2: there أَرْبَعَةٌ stood alone as a khabar and wore a tanwin; here it governs a noun and loses it. Same word, two offices.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the plural of «qism», and in meaning the DISTINGUISHER: it says what the bare number is a number OF.
A badal of «four», in raf' — a badal of DETAIL. It is the ism fa'il of خَصَّ, its two identical letters run together.
Joined, in raf' — the ism fa'il of عَمَّ; its origin is عَامِمٌ, and the two mims were run together.
Joined, in raf' — the ism maf'ul of اِشْتَرَكَ on مُفْتَعَل.
Joined, in raf' — the ism maf'ul of أَوَّلَ on مُفَعَّل, and with it the four kinds are complete.

sentences.text: فَالْخَاصُّ مَا وُضِعَ لِمَعْنًى وَاحِدٍ عَلَى الِانْفِرَادِ

translation.en: The specific is what was set down for a single meaning, on its own.
translation.tr: Hâss, tek bir mânâ için tek başına vaz' edilmiş olandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A «telling» fa, or one joining for detail, and «the specific» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb built for the UNNAMED DOER; the naib al-fa'il is a hidden pronoun going back to «what», and the clause is the sila — i'rabless. It is a MITHAL WAWI: its waw fell out of يَضَعُ, and it comes BACK in the passive يُوضَعُ. That return is the cleanest proof available that the waw was dropped by its surroundings, not because a waw is weak in itself.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «was set down» — and «a meaning» is a MAQSUR noun: its jarr is a kasra that cannot be written, so it is UNDERSTOOD, and the tanwin sits on the alif itself.

A na't of «a meaning», in jarr by the kasra — and the kasra SHOWS on it, because it ends in a sound letter, unlike the word it describes. The pair is worth staring at: the same case, written on one and understood on the other.
A jarr letter; the phrase is a HAL from the pronoun inside «was set down».
In jarr after «ala» — the masdar of اِنْفَرَدَ on اِنْفِعَال, and by it the SHARED word is shut out: it is set down for meanings, not for one meaning standing alone.

sentences.text: وَحُكْمُهُ أَنْ يُوجِبَ الْحُكْمَ قَطْعًا

translation.en: And its ruling is that it obliges the judgement decisively.
translation.tr: Hükmü, hükmü kat'î olarak îcâb etmesidir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ خَبَرُهَا مَصْدَرٌ مُؤَوَّلٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause whose khabar is a masdar muawwal — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «ruling» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf, and the HA is the mudaf ilayh, in the position of jarr.
A MASDAR-MAKING letter that puts the mudari into nasb — it melts the clause after it down into a masdar.
A mudari in nasb after «an», its mark the fatha, with a hidden pronoun going back to «the specific» for its fa'il — and the MASDAR MUAWWAL («its obliging») is the khabar of «its ruling».
The maf'ul bihi, in nasb by the fatha.

A MAF'UL MUTLAQ in nasb, telling the KIND of the obliging; some read it instead as a hal, «cutting off doubt». The two readings meet in one sense: there is no other possibility left open. This is the whole point of the khass — it does not admit an alternative.

sentences.text: وَالْعَامُّ لَفْظٌ مُسْتَغْرِقٌ لِجَمِيعِ مَا يَصْلُحُ لَهُ

translation.en: And the general is a wording that takes in everything it is fit for.
translation.tr: Âmm, kendisine elverişli olan her şeyi kuşatan lafızdır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the general» is the mubtada in raf'.
The khabar in raf', with a tanwin — and it comes INDEFINITE because what is meant is the kind, not one particular word.
A na't of «a wording», in raf' — the ism fa'il of اِسْتَغْرَقَ on مُسْتَفْعِل, and it GOVERNS like its verb, which is why the jarr after it attaches to it.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «taking in», and «all of» is a mudaf.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of jarr as the mudaf ilayh.
A mudari in raf' by the damma, with a hidden pronoun for its fa'il — and the clause is the sila of the relative, i'rabless.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «is fit» — and the whole definition turns on it: what the wording is NOT fit for does not fall under it.

sentences.text: وَالْمُشْتَرَكُ مَا وُضِعَ لِمَعَانٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ

translation.en: And the shared is what was set down for differing meanings.
translation.tr: Müşterek, birbirinden farklı mânâlar için vaz' edilmiş olandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the shared» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb built for the unnamed doer; the clause is the sila. The definition repeats word for word what was said of the khass and changes ONE thing — what follows the lam. That one change is the whole difference.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «was set down» — and «meanings» is the hard case in this chapter. It is a MUNTAHA AL-JUMU', so it is BARRED FROM TANWIN; and yet a tanwin is written on it. Both are true: being a MANQUS, it drops its ya in raf' and in jarr, and the tanwin standing there is a tanwin of COMPENSATION for the dropped letter, not the tanwin of the indefinite. Put it in nasb and both facts show at once: رَأَيْتُ مَعَانِيَ — the ya returns, and the fatha comes bare.
A na't of «meanings», in jarr — the ism fa'il of اِخْتَلَفَ, and by it the merely general word is shut out, whose meanings are all of one kind.

sentences.text: وَالْمُؤَوَّلُ مَا تَرَجَّحَ بَعْضُ وُجُوهِهِ بِغَالِبِ الرَّأْيِ

translation.en: And the interpreted is that one of whose faces has been given the stronger weight by preponderant judgement.
translation.tr: Müevvel, vecihlerinden biri gālib re'y ile tercîh edilmiş olandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the interpreted» is the mubtada in raf' — the fourth and last.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb on تَفَعَّلَ, the MUTAWA'A of رَجَّحَ — «to be given the stronger weight» — and the clause is the sila. The Form V is chosen on purpose: the weighing is done BY the mujtahid, and the wording is what RECEIVES it. A muawwal is not a word that weighs itself.
The fa'il in raf', and a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr, and itself a mudaf, with the HA as a second mudaf ilayh — a chain of THREE. «Faces» is the plural of wajh: the meanings a wording will bear.
The BA of cause or of instrument, and «the preponderant» in jarr after it and a mudaf — the ism fa'il of غَلَبَ.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr — and with it the muawwal parts company with the mufassar: the one is settled by a decisive text, the other by preponderant judgement, and so it remains open to error. That admission is deliberate, and it is why the muawwal is the weakest of the four.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ اللَّفْظُ بِاعْتِبَارِ وُضُوحِ الْمَعْنَى أَرْبَعَةٌ ظَاهِرٌ وَنَصٌّ وَمُفَسَّرٌ وَمُحْكَمٌ

translation.en: Then the wording, taken by the clearness of its meaning, is four: the manifest, the explicit, the expounded and the firm.
translation.tr: Lafız, mânâsının vuzûhu itibarıyla dörttür: zâhir, nass, müfesser ve muhkem.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ اسْتِئْنَافِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: An isti'naf nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval — with it the matn steps from dividing the wording by what it was SET DOWN for to dividing it by how plainly it SHOWS.
The mubtada in raf' — the very same mubtada the chapter before opened with. The word being divided has not changed; the RULER being held against it has.

A jarr-majrur hanging on an omitted word that stands as a hal, and «taken by» is a mudaf — the masdar of اِعْتَبَرَ on اِفْتِعَال. It is the word that announces a change of criterion, and every division in the book is introduced by it.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr, and itself a mudaf — the masdar of وَضَحَ.

The mudaf ilayh, in jarr by a kasra ESTIMATED on the alif, which cannot carry one. It is the same maqsur the chapter before showed indefinite as مَعْنًى — here made definite by ال, so the tanwin is gone and nothing at all is written on the end.

The khabar in raf', with its tanwin — NOT a mudaf here, unlike أَرْبَعَةُ أَقْسَامٍ in the chapter before. The tanwin is the whole difference, and it is worth pausing on: the same numeral, the same office, and one letter telling you whether a noun follows it.
A badal of detail from «four», in raf' — the ism fa'il of ظَهَرَ.
Joined, in raf' — the masdar of نَصَّ used in the sense of the passive participle: the thing spoken out plainly.
Joined, in raf' — the ism maf'ul of فَسَّرَ on مُفَعَّل.
Joined, in raf' — the ism maf'ul of أَحْكَمَ on مُفْعَل, and with it the four degrees are complete.

sentences.text: فَالظَّاهِرُ مَا ظَهَرَ الْمُرَادُ مِنْهُ بِنَفْسِ السَّمَاعِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَأَمُّلٍ

translation.en: So the manifest is that whose intended sense shows by the very hearing of it, with no reflection.
translation.tr: Zâhir, murâdı sırf işitmekle, hiç düşünmeye gerek kalmadan ortaya çıkandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A fa joining for detail; «the manifest» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar — and it opens the definition of all four kinds alike.

A past verb; the clause is the sila of the relative and has no position in i'rab. Its fa'il is NAMED after it, unlike the silas of the chapter before, where the fa'il was a hidden pronoun going back to «ma».
The fa'il in raf' — the ism maf'ul of أَرَادَ. The root is hollow, so the shape comes out مُفَال after the i'lal has run, not *مُرْوَد.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «shows», and the HA goes back to «that which». This returning pronoun is what ties the sila to its relative — a sila without one is not a sila.
The BA of cause, and «the very» in jarr after it and a mudaf. It is brought for restriction: by the hearing ALONE, with nothing else added.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of سَمِعَ.
A jarr letter; the phrase is a hal from «the intended sense».
In jarr after «min», and a mudaf — and «ghayr» never becomes definite by its idafa, however definite the noun after it, because it is too vague in itself to be pinned down.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of تَأَمَّلَ on تَفَعُّل, and this is the clause that separates the manifest from anything needing thought to reach.

sentences.text: وَالنَّصُّ مَا ازْدَادَ وُضُوحًا عَلَى الظَّاهِرِ بِمَعْنًى مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّمِ

translation.en: And the explicit is that which has grown clearer than the manifest by a sense coming from the speaker.
translation.tr: Nass, mütekellimden gelen bir mânâ ile zâhirden daha vâzıh hâle gelendir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the explicit» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb with a hidden pronoun for its fa'il going back to «that which»; the clause is the sila. It is ز ي د run through اِفْتِعَال, and TWO rules fire in it: the ta of the pattern turns into a DAL after a zay — اِزْتَادَ becomes اِزْدَادَ — and then the hollow middle melts into an alif. Note that the dal does NOT swallow the zay: they are different letters, so both stand. Where the two do come out the same, as in اِطَّلَعَ and اِدَّعَى, they run together.
A TAMYIZ in nasb — and of the kind called تَمْيِيزُ النِّسْبَةِ: the clause leaves it vague WHAT increased, and this mansub noun settles it. Ask «increased in what?» and the answer is the tamyiz.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «has grown» — and «ala» here marks the thing surpassed.
In jarr after «ala» — and by naming it the definition becomes a LADDER: each degree is the one before it plus something. The four are not four separate things but one thing measured.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «has grown», and «a sense» is an indefinite maqsur: its jarr is a kasra that cannot be written, and its tanwin is written as a fathatan on the alif, exactly as it was in the chapter before.
A jarr letter for the start of the span — its nun takes a fatha because two sukuns met.
In jarr after «min» — the ism fa'il of تَكَلَّمَ, and by it whatever grew clearer from an OUTSIDE indication is shut out. The extra clearness of a nass must come from the speaker himself.

sentences.text: وَالْمُفَسَّرُ مَا ازْدَادَ وُضُوحًا عَلَى النَّصِّ بِحَيْثُ انْسَدَّ بَابُ التَّأْوِيلِ

translation.en: And the expounded is that which has grown clearer than the explicit, so that the door of interpretation is shut.
translation.tr: Müfesser, nasstan daha vâzıh hâle gelip te'vîl kapısı kapanandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ لِـ«حَيْثُ».
jumal.en: A verbal clause in the position of jarr, the mudaf ilayh of «haythu».

human.irab: A joining waw; «the expounded» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb; the clause is the sila. The SAME verb in all three remaining definitions is deliberate: it is what makes the four a ladder rather than a list.
A TAMYIZ in nasb — and of the kind called تَمْيِيزُ النِّسْبَةِ: the clause leaves it vague WHAT increased, and this mansub noun settles it. Ask «increased in what?» and the answer is the tamyiz.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «has grown», marking the thing surpassed.
In jarr after «ala» — and the rung being measured against is the one just before, not the first. The ladder is climbed one step at a time.

The BA is a jarr letter, and «haythu» is an adverb FIXED on the damma, in the position of jarr — and it is a mudaf to a whole SENTENCE. Most nouns take a noun for their mudaf ilayh; haythu takes a clause, and is one of the very few words that does.

A past verb on اِنْفَعَلَ — a DOUBLED root whose two identical letters have met and been run together; its origin is انْسَدَدَ, and the uncontracted form comes back the moment a sukun-bearing ending follows (انْسَدَدْتُ). The clause is in the position of jarr, because haythu is added to it.
The fa'il in raf', and a mudaf. Calling interpretation a DOOR is a deliberate figure: a door that is shut is not a door you may still knock at.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of أَوَّلَ on تَفْعِيل: turning a wording away from its plain sense on the strength of an indication. It is the same root that gave الْمُؤَوَّل in the chapter before.

sentences.text: وَالْمُحْكَمُ مَا ازْدَادَ وُضُوحًا عَلَى الْمُفَسَّرِ بِحَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَمِلُ النَّسْخَ

translation.en: And the firm is that which has grown clearer than the expounded, so that it does not admit abrogation.
translation.tr: Muhkem, müfesserden daha vâzıh hâle gelip nesih ihtimâli taşımayandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ لِـ«حَيْثُ».
jumal.en: A verbal clause in the position of jarr, the mudaf ilayh of «haythu».

human.irab: A joining waw; «the firm» is the mubtada in raf' — the last of the degrees.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb; the clause is the sila — the third time, and with it the ladder is complete.
A TAMYIZ in nasb — and of the kind called تَمْيِيزُ النِّسْبَةِ: the clause leaves it vague WHAT increased, and this mansub noun settles it. Ask «increased in what?» and the answer is the tamyiz.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «has grown», marking the thing surpassed.
In jarr after «ala» — the rung immediately below.
The BA is a jarr letter, and «haythu» an adverb fixed on the damma, added to the clause after it.
«La» here simply DENIES and governs nothing: the verb after it keeps the raf' it would have had anyway. It is neither the la that puts a mudari into jazm nor the one that denies a whole genus.

A mudari in raf' by the damma, with a hidden pronoun for its fa'il — ح م ل on اِفْتِعَال, and its TA stands unchanged, because the ha is not one of the letters that force the ibdal. Set it beside اِزْدَادَ in the same chapter and the rule shows itself: the ta changes only after certain letters, and stays put after all the rest.

The maf'ul bihi in nasb — the masdar of نَسَخَ: the lifting of a legal ruling by a later legal indication. Not admitting it is the highest degree of clearness a wording can reach, and that is why the ladder ends here.

sentences.text: وَفِي مُقَابَلَتِهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ خَفِيٌّ وَمُشْكِلٌ وَمُجْمَلٌ وَمُتَشَابِهٌ

translation.en: And facing them are four: the hidden, the difficult, the summary and the ambiguous.
translation.tr: Bunların karşısında da dört vardır: hafî, müşkil, mücmel ve müteşâbih.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ خَبَرُهَا مُقَدَّمٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause with its khabar fronted — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw, and «fi» a jarr letter whose phrase stands as the khabar, placed FIRST.

In jarr after «fi» and a mudaf, with the HA as its mudaf ilayh going back to the degrees of clearness — the masdar of قَابَلَ on مُفَاعَلَة. The word announces that what follows is not a new list but the OTHER SIDE of the one just given.
The mubtada, in raf' and coming LAST. An indefinite noun may not normally start a sentence — and here it does not: the khabar came first, and that is precisely the licence.
A badal of detail, in raf' — a sifa mushabbaha on فَعِيل from خَفِيَ.
Joined, in raf' — the ism fa'il of أَشْكَلَ: literally the thing that has got in among its own look-alikes and cannot be picked out from them.
Joined, in raf' — the ism maf'ul of أَجْمَلَ on مُفْعَل: the thing left summed up rather than spelled out.
Joined, in raf' — the ism fa'il of تَشَابَهَ on مُتَفَاعِل, and Form VI is the form of MUTUALITY: the parts have come to resemble one another until none can be told from the rest.

sentences.text: فَالْخَفِيُّ مَا خَفِيَ مُرَادُهُ بِعَارِضٍ لَا مِنْ نَفْسِ الصِّيغَةِ

translation.en: So the hidden is that whose intended sense is hidden by something incidental, not by the wording itself.
translation.tr: Hafî, murâdı ârızî bir sebeple gizlenen — sîganın kendisinden değil — lafızdır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A fa joining for detail; «the hidden» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb, a NAQIS YAI of the sami'a bab; the clause is the sila. Its ya stands on the page here because it carries a vowel, and it falls out the moment an ending would leave it sitting on a sukun: خَفُوا.
The fa'il in raf' and a mudaf, with the HA as its mudaf ilayh — and that HA is the pronoun that ties the sila back to «that which».
The BA of cause, and «something incidental» in jarr after it — the ism fa'il of عَرَضَ: whatever has come upon the word from outside.

«La» joining and denying: it takes back from the second what was granted to the first. It is the small word that carries the whole definition — the obscurity must come from OUTSIDE, or the word is not a khafi at all.
A jarr letter; in meaning the phrase is joined to «by something incidental».
In jarr after «min» and a mudaf — «the very» is brought to close a door: not from the wording ITSELF, whatever else may be true of it.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — and this clause is what separates the hidden from the summary: the summary is obscure BY ITS WORDING, the hidden only by what has happened to it.

sentences.text: وَالْمُشْكِلُ مَا ازْدَادَ خَفَاءً بِحَيْثُ لَا يُنَالُ الْمُرَادُ إِلَّا بِالطَّلَبِ

translation.en: And the difficult is that which has grown more obscure, so that the intended sense is not reached except by searching.
translation.tr: Müşkil, kapalılığı artıp murâda ancak araştırmayla ulaşılabilendir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ لِـ«حَيْثُ».
jumal.en: A verbal clause in the position of jarr, the mudaf ilayh of «haythu».

human.irab: A joining waw; «the difficult» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb; the clause is the sila. It is the SAME verb the degrees of clearness were built on — only the tamyiz after it has changed. The two chapters are one table read from its two ends.

A TAMYIZ in nasb, of the nisba kind — the exact counterpart of وُضُوحًا in the chapter before. And note what it is: a MAMDUD noun that KEEPS its tanwin, because its hamza is the root's own ya (خ ف ي) turned into one. صَحْرَاءُ ends in the same three letters and is barred from tanwin, because its hamza is the alif of feminisation. Nothing on the page distinguishes them; only the root does.
The BA is a jarr letter, and «haythu» an adverb fixed on the damma, added to the clause after it.
«La» simply denying, and governing nothing — but it is the CONDITION for what comes next: the mufarragh exception only works after a negation.
A mudari built for the unnamed doer, in raf' — a HOLLOW verb: نَالَ يَنَالُ, and in the passive the middle stays an alif, يُنَالُ.
The naib al-fa'il, in raf'.

The particle of exception — and the exception is MUFARRAGH, «emptied»: a negation came before it and no mustathna minhu was ever named, so the governor is left FREE to reach past إِلَّا and give what follows the i'rab it was holding. إِلَّا itself governs nothing here; it only removes the denial.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «is reached» — and this is the emptied exception itself. Take إِلَّا away and the sentence still parses: «الْمُرَادُ يُنَالُ بِالطَّلَبِ». That is the test for a mufarragh, and it is the only exception whose i'rab comes from the governor rather than from إِلَّا.

sentences.text: وَالْمُجْمَلُ مَا ازْدَادَ خَفَاءً بِحَيْثُ لَا يُدْرَكُ إِلَّا بِبَيَانٍ مِنَ الْمُجْمِلِ

translation.en: And the summary is that which has grown more obscure, so that it is not grasped except by an explanation from the one who summarised.
translation.tr: Mücmel, kapalılığı artıp ancak icmâl edenin beyânıyla anlaşılabilendir.

jumal.text: لَا يُدْرَكُ إِلَّا بِبَيَانٍ مِنَ الْمُجْمِلِ
jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ لِـ«حَيْثُ».
jumal.en: A verbal clause in the position of jarr, the mudaf ilayh of «haythu».

human.irab: A joining waw; «the summary» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb; the clause is the sila — the second step down.

A TAMYIZ in nasb, of the nisba kind — the exact counterpart of وُضُوحًا in the chapter before. And note what it is: a MAMDUD noun that KEEPS its tanwin, because its hamza is the root's own ya (خ ف ي) turned into one. صَحْرَاءُ ends in the same three letters and is barred from tanwin, because its hamza is the alif of feminisation. Nothing on the page distinguishes them; only the root does.
The BA is a jarr letter, and «haythu» is added to the clause after it.
«La» simply denying, and governing nothing.

A mudari built for the unnamed doer, in raf', from أَدْرَكَ — and its naib al-fa'il is a hidden pronoun going back to «that which». Note that the mudari of Form IV drops the hamza: أَدْرَكَ gives يُدْرِكُ, never *يُؤَدْرِكُ.
The particle of exception, the exception again mufarragh as before.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «is grasped» — the masdar of بَيَّنَ.
A jarr letter for the start of the span — its nun takes a fatha because two sukuns met.

In jarr after «min» — the ism fa'il of أَجْمَلَ. Between it and الْمُجْمَل at the head of this very sentence there stands ONE vowel: a kasra on the mim makes it the one who summarised, a fatha makes it the thing summarised. The whole definition turns on that vowel, and a text without vowels leaves the reader to supply it.

sentences.text: وَالْمُتَشَابِهُ مَا انْقَطَعَ رَجَاءُ مَعْرِفَةِ مُرَادِهِ

translation.en: And the ambiguous is that whose hope of knowing its intended sense has been cut off.
translation.tr: Müteşâbih, murâdını bilme ümidi kesilmiş olandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the ambiguous» is the mubtada in raf' — the bottom of the descent.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb on اِنْفَعَلَ, the mutawa'a of قَطَعَ; the clause is the sila. The matn does not say «what is not known» — it says the HOPE itself has been cut. Searching helped with the mushkil; here it does not, and the difference is deliberate.
The fa'il in raf' and a mudaf — the masdar of رَجَا, and a mamdud whose hamza comes from a waw, so it too keeps its tanwin when indefinite. It heads a chain of four.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr, and itself a mudaf — the second link.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr and itself a mudaf, with the HA as a further mudaf ilayh — so the chain runs FOUR links deep: رَجَاءُ ← مَعْرِفَةِ ← مُرَادِ ← the HA. Every link in the middle is a mudaf and a mudaf ilayh at the same time, and only the last is not itself a mudaf.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ وُجُوهُ الْبَيَانِ أَرْبَعَةٌ عِبَارَةُ النَّصِّ وَإِشَارَتُهُ وَدَلَالَتُهُ وَاقْتِضَاؤُهُ

translation.en: Then the ways of setting forth are four: the text's plain wording, its indication, its implication and its requirement.
translation.tr: Beyânın vecihleri dörttür: nassın ibâresi, işâreti, delâleti ve iktizâsı.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ اسْتِئْنَافِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: An isti'naf nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval — and the question has changed. The two chapters before asked how plainly the wording SHOWS; this one asks how a ruling is GOT OUT of it.
The mubtada in raf' and a mudaf — the plural of «wajh», which the chapter before showed added to a pronoun in وُجُوهِهِ. Same word, same office, a different thing added to it.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of بَيَّنَ; and what is meant here is the ROUTE by which a meaning is got out, not merely making a thing clear.

The khabar in raf' with its tanwin — not a mudaf, as in the clarity chapter and unlike the divisions chapter. Three chapters now have used this one numeral in two different offices; the tanwin is the tell.
A badal of detail, in raf' and a mudaf — the masdar of عَبَّرَ.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the very word that was the second rung of the clarity ladder, used here in its wider sense: the revealed wording, whatever its degree.

Joined, in raf' and a mudaf — the masdar of أَشَارَ, and the verb is HOLLOW: once the middle radical melted, إِفْعَال could not stand, so a TA MARBUTA came in to make good the loss. Exactly the compensation chapter 3 showed on تَعْدِيَة — there for a weak LAM, here for a weak AYN. One remedy, two injuries.
Joined, in raf' and a mudaf — the masdar of دَلَّ, from the same root د ل ل that gave الدَّلِيل at the head of the book.

Joined, in raf' and a mudaf — the masdar of اِقْتَضَى on اِفْتِعَال. Its hamza rides a WAW because the vowel on it is a damma, and the damma outranks every other vowel when the seat is chosen. Put the same word in jarr and the seat changes: اقْتِضَائِهِ.

sentences.text: فَعِبَارَةُ النَّصِّ مَا سِيقَ الْكَلَامُ لَهُ

translation.en: So the text's plain wording is that for which the speech was uttered.
translation.tr: Nassın ibâresi, sözün kendisi için sevk edildiği mânâdır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A fa joining for detail; «the wording of» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb built for the unnamed doer; the clause is the sila. It is an AJWAF WAWI: سَاقَ has a waw for its middle radical, and when the verb is built for the passive the letter before that middle takes a KASRA, which turns the waw into a YA. قَالَ gives قِيلَ, بَاعَ gives بِيعَ, سَاقَ gives سِيقَ — one rule, and the active form does not show it.
The naib al-fa'il, in raf'.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «was uttered», its HA going back to «that which» — and this little phrase IS the whole definition: the sense the speech was uttered FOR, not everything that can be understood from it.

sentences.text: وَإِشَارَتُهُ مَا ثَبَتَ بِنَظْمِ الْكَلَامِ لُغَةً وَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَقْصُودًا

translation.en: And its indication is what is established by the arrangement of the speech as a matter of language, without having been aimed at.
translation.tr: İşâreti, sözün nazmıyla lugat cihetinden sâbit olan, fakat kastedilmemiş olandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ مَعْطُوفَةٌ عَلَى الصِّلَةِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause joined to the sila — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «its indication» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf, with the HA as its mudaf ilayh.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb with a hidden pronoun for its fa'il, going back to «that which»; the clause is the sila.
The BA of cause, and «the arrangement of» in jarr after it and a mudaf. NAZM is the ordering of the words themselves — not what they mean, which is the next definition's business.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr.
A TAMYIZ in nasb: «as a matter of LANGUAGE», and by it whatever is established by a jurist's effort is shut out. Ask «established in what respect?» and this word is the answer.
A joining waw, and «lam» — a letter that DENIES, puts into JAZM, and TURNS THE TIME: the verb after it is a mudari in form and a past in meaning.

A mudari of the incomplete kind, in JAZM after «lam» with a sukun for its sign, its ism a hidden pronoun. The waw is gone: يَكُونْ would put a long vowel against a sukun, and two sukuns will not stand, so the weak letter is the one that gives way. This is the hollow verb's whole story in one cell.

The khabar of «yakun», in nasb — the ism maf'ul of قَصَدَ, and this is the clause that parts the indication from the plain wording: the one is what the speech was said FOR, the other is what it was NOT said for and yet establishes all the same.

sentences.text: وَدَلَالَتُهُ مَا ثَبَتَ بِمَعْنَى النَّظْمِ لُغَةً لَا بِاجْتِهَادٍ

translation.en: And its implication is what is established by the sense of the arrangement, as a matter of language, not by a jurist's effort.
translation.tr: Delâleti, nazmın mânâsıyla lugat cihetinden sâbit olandır — ictihadla değil.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «its implication» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf, with the HA as its mudaf ilayh.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb; the clause is the sila. The verb is repeated word for word from the definition before, and ONE phrase after it changes — بِنَظْمِ becomes بِمَعْنَى النَّظْمِ. That single swap is the whole distinction between an indication and an implication.

The BA of cause, and «the sense of» in jarr by a kasra ESTIMATED on the alif, and a mudaf — so it wears no tanwin, because a mudaf never does. The maqsur has now been seen three ways in this package: indefinite (مَعْنًى), definite by ال (الْمَعْنَى) and definite by idafa (مَعْنَى) — and it is written differently in each.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr.
A tamyiz in nasb, repeated to keep the restriction standing: in BOTH of these ways the thing is established by the language itself.
«La» joining and denying: it takes back from the second what was granted to the first.

A joined jarr-majrur — the masdar of اِجْتَهَدَ on اِفْتِعَال, from the same word that gave الْمُجْتَهِدُونَ in the chapter on consensus. What a dalala yields, any competent reader of Arabic can see; it does not wait on a jurist.

sentences.text: وَاقْتِضَاؤُهُ مَا لَا يَسْتَقِيمُ الْكَلَامُ إِلَّا بِهِ

translation.en: And its requirement is that without which the speech will not stand.
translation.tr: İktizâsı, kendisi olmadıkça sözün düzgün olmadığı şeydir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «its requirement» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf — the hamza riding a waw for the damma on it.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
«La» simply denying, and governing nothing — and it is the condition for the emptied exception coming next.

A mudari in raf' by the damma, on اِسْتَفْعَلَ — an AJWAF WAWI from ق و م. The waw turned into a ya because the letter before it took a kasra: يَسْتَقْوِمُ became يَسْتَقِيمُ. Set it beside سِيقَ in this same chapter and the pair is the i'lal chapter in miniature — a waw becoming a ya, once in the passive and once under a kasra.
The fa'il, in raf'.

The particle of exception, the exception MUFARRAGH — the second in this book, after لَا يُنَالُ … إِلَّا بِالطَّلَبِ. Two chapters, one construction, different verbs: that is what a construction looks like once you can see it.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «will stand», its HA going back to «that which» — and it is the emptied exception itself. Drop إِلَّا and the sentence still parses: يَسْتَقِيمُ الْكَلَامُ بِهِ.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ الْأَمْرُ قَوْلٌ يُطْلَبُ بِهِ الْفِعْلُ عَلَى جِهَةِ الِاسْتِعْلَاءِ

translation.en: Then the command is an utterance by which the doing of a thing is sought, in the manner of one above.
translation.tr: Emir, kendisiyle bir fiilin, üstünlük cihetiyle istendiği sözdür.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ اسْتِئْنَافِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: An isti'naf nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ نَعْتٌ لِـ«قَوْلٌ».
jumal.en: A verbal clause in the position of raf', a na't of «an utterance».

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval — with it the matn steps from the ROUTES a meaning travels to the two forms that carry most of the rulings there are.

The mubtada in raf' — the masdar of أَمَرَ, and what is meant here is the FORM, not the other أَمْر that means an affair or a matter. The same three letters carry both, and the plurals part them: أَوَامِر for this one, أُمُور for that.
The khabar in raf' with its tanwin, and INDEFINITE because what is meant is the kind, not one particular utterance.

A mudari built for the unnamed doer, in raf'; and the clause is in the position of raf' as a NA'T of «an utterance». A clause after an indefinite noun is a description of it — after a definite one it would be a hal. That single rule settles what this whole sentence is doing.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «is sought», its HA going back to «an utterance» — and that returning pronoun is what ties the description to the thing described. A na't clause without one is not a na't clause.
The naib al-fa'il, in raf' — and it is the thing sought: that the act be done.
A jarr letter.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «is sought», and «the manner of» is a mudaf. ISTI'LA is that the one asking counts himself ABOVE the one asked — and it is the word that keeps a request and an entreaty out of the definition.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of اِسْتَعْلَى on اِسْتِفْعَال, and a MAMDUD whose hamza is the root's own waw (ع ل و) turned into one. So it is munsarif: put it in jarr while indefinite and it takes a kasra with a tanwin, exactly as خَفَاءً did, and not the bare fatha of صَحْرَاءَ.

sentences.text: وَمُوجِبُهُ الْوُجُوبُ عِنْدَ الْإِطْلَاقِ وَقَدْ يَرِدُ لِلنَّدْبِ وَالْإِبَاحَةِ بِقَرِينَةٍ

translation.en: And what it obliges is obligation, when it comes unqualified; and it may come for recommendation or for permission, with an indication.
translation.tr: Mutlak geldiğinde îcâb ettiği şey vücûbdur; bir karîneyle nedb yahut ibâha için de gelebilir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ مَعْطُوفَةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A joined verbal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «what it obliges» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf — the ism fa'il of أَوْجَبَ, the very verb chapter 4 used in أَنْ يُوجِبَ. It is a MITHAL WAWI, and the waw sits after a damma, where it is already a madd letter and carries no sukun: مُوجِب, not *مُوْجِب. Same rule, same root, a different cell of the same paradigm.

The khabar in raf' — the masdar of وَجَبَ on فُعُول. Set it beside مُوجِب and the pair is a lesson in itself: أَوْجَبَ is what the command DOES, وَجَبَ is what then HOLDS. The one is the cause, the other the effect, and Form IV is the whole difference between them.
A time-adverb in nasb and a mudaf, hanging on an omitted word that stands as a hal.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of أَطْلَقَ on إِفْعَال: that the command should come stripped of every indication. This is the hinge of the whole chapter — everything said here is said of the UNQUALIFIED case.
A joining waw, and «qad» — before a MUDARI it means «sometimes», before a MADI it means «indeed». Same letter, opposite work, and the verb after it decides which.

A mudari in raf' by the damma — a MITHAL WAWI whose waw has dropped: يَوْرِدُ became يَرِدُ, because the waw stood between a ya and a KASRA. That kasra is the whole cause, which is why يَوْجَلُ, with a fatha after it, keeps its waw.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «may come», the LAM giving the reason — and a nadb is a request that does not bind: doing it earns, leaving it costs nothing.

Joined, in jarr — the masdar of أَبَاحَ, a HOLLOW verb whose melted middle is made good in the masdar by a ta marbuta: إِبَاحَة, not *إِبْوَاح. Exactly إِشَارَة in the chapter before. Two chapters, two verbs, one compensation.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «may come» — and it is what keeps the definition honest: the default is obligation, and a default is not abandoned without something to abandon it FOR.

sentences.text: وَالنَّهْيُ قَوْلٌ يُطْلَبُ بِهِ الْكَفُّ عَنِ الْفِعْلِ عَلَى جِهَةِ الِاسْتِعْلَاءِ

translation.en: And the prohibition is an utterance by which holding back from a thing is sought, in the manner of one above.
translation.tr: Nehiy, kendisiyle bir fiilden el çekmenin, üstünlük cihetiyle istendiği sözdür.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the prohibition» is the mubtada in raf' — the masdar of نَهَى, a naqis yai.
The khabar in raf' with its tanwin — and the definition is cast in the command's own mould, word for word. Only one phrase inside it changes, and that phrase is the whole difference.
A mudari built for the unnamed doer; the clause is a na't of «an utterance», in the position of raf'.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «is sought», the HA the tie.

The naib al-fa'il, in raf' — the masdar of كَفَّ. THIS is the one word that has changed from the command's definition: there the thing sought was الْفِعْلُ, the doing; here it is الْكَفُّ, the holding back. Everything else in the two sentences is identical, and a reader who notices that has understood both at once.
A jarr letter of turning away from, attaching to «the holding back» — a masdar governs like its verb, which is why it can take an object of its own. Its nun takes a kasra because two sukuns met.
In jarr after «an».
A jarr letter.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «is sought», and «the manner of» is a mudaf. ISTI'LA is that the one asking counts himself ABOVE the one asked — and it is the word that keeps a request and an entreaty out of the definition.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr, repeated word for word: the same restriction binds both kinds of request. Without it, a prayer would be a command.

sentences.text: وَمُوجِبُهُ التَّحْرِيمُ عِنْدَ الْإِطْلَاقِ وَقَدْ يَرِدُ لِلْكَرَاهَةِ

translation.en: And what it obliges is forbiddenness, when it comes unqualified; and it may come for mere dislike.
translation.tr: Mutlak geldiğinde îcâb ettiği şey tahrîmdir; kerâhet için de gelebilir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «what it obliges» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf, its HA going back to «the prohibition» this time.

The khabar in raf' — the masdar of حَرَّمَ on تَفْعِيل, and its lam is a SOUND letter, so the pattern stands as it is. Set it against تَعْدِيَة in chapter 3, where the lam was weak and a ta marbuta had to come in. Same wazn, two outcomes, and the root decides.
An adverb in nasb, and a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the same restriction the command was given.
A joining waw, and «qad» for «sometimes» before a mudari.
A mudari in raf' — a mithal whose waw has dropped.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «may come» — and dislike is a step below forbiddenness, just as the command stepped down to recommendation. The two sentences fall the same distance, which is the point of writing them as a pair.

sentences.text: وَصِيغَةُ الْأَمْرِ افْعَلْ وَمَا نَابَ عَنْهَا وَصِيغَةُ النَّهْيِ لَا تَفْعَلْ

translation.en: And the form of the command is «do», and what stands in its place; and the form of the prohibition is «do not do».
translation.tr: Emrin sîgası «افْعَلْ» ve onun yerini tutanlardır; nehyin sîgası ise «لَا تَفْعَلْ»dır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the form of» is the mubtada in raf' and a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr.

The khabar, in the POSITION of raf' — a word QUOTED for its own shape, so it wears no ending of its own. In itself it is an imperative, fixed on a sukun, and its alif is a WASL alif brought in only because Arabic cannot begin on a silent letter. Put anything at all before it and the alif stops being pronounced: وَافْعَلْ.
A joining waw, and «ma» a relative noun joined to it, in the position of raf'.

A past verb, an AJWAF WAWI from ن و ب; the clause is the sila. This little joining is what keeps the command from being trapped in one written shape: a mudari in jazm after the lam of command stands in for it, and so does a masdar, and so does a statement meant as a demand. A definition tied to a single spelling would have been false.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «stands in», the pronoun going back to «the form».
A joining waw, and «the form of» a second mubtada in raf' and a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr.

«La» of PROHIBITION, and it puts the verb into jazm — not the plain denying «la» that stood in the chapter on the muhkam. That one governs nothing; this one does. Two letters spelled the same, and only the ending of the verb after them tells you which you are reading.

A mudari in JAZM after the prohibiting «la», its sign a sukun — and it too is quoted for its own shape, the pair standing as the khabar in the position of raf'. Note the whole lesson of the sentence: the command has its own form, the prohibition borrows the present tense and bends it.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ الْخَاصُّ يَنْقَسِمُ إِلَى مُطْلَقٍ وَمُقَيَّدٍ

translation.en: Then the specific divides into unrestricted and restricted.
translation.tr: Hâss, mutlak ve mukayyed olmak üzere ikiye ayrılır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ خَبَرُهَا جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause whose khabar is a verbal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval.
The fa'il in raf' — the very khass that was defined in chapter 4, come back now to be divided. A term is defined once and then worked; that is how a matn is built.

A mudari in raf' on اِنْفَعَلَ — the MUTAWA'A of قَسَمَ: that verb divides something else, this one is the thing dividing of itself. Form VII is the whole difference, and the matn chose it deliberately: the division is in the wording's own nature, not something a jurist does to it.
A jarr letter — and it belongs to the verb's meaning: اِنْقَسَمَ does not stand without it. A verb whose preposition is part of it is learned WITH the preposition, never apart from it.

In jarr after «ila» — the ism maf'ul of أَطْلَقَ on مُفْعَل, whose masdar الْإِطْلَاق stood in the chapter on the command. The pair is worth holding together: there the word named a STATE a command could be in, here it names a wording that is in it.
Joined, in jarr — the ism maf'ul of قَيَّدَ on مُفَعَّل: the wording that has had a fetter put on it.

sentences.text: فَالْمُطْلَقُ مَا تَنَاوَلَ وَاحِدًا لَا بِعَيْنِهِ

translation.en: So the unrestricted is what takes in one instance, not one in particular.
translation.tr: Mutlak, muayyen olmayan bir ferdi kapsayandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A fa joining for detail; «the unrestricted» is the mubtada in raf'.

A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar — and it is the mould every definition in this book is cast in. A definite noun, a مَا, and a clause: read that shape once and the rest of the matn reads itself.

A past verb on تَفَاعَلَ; the clause is the sila. Form VI is the form of MUTUALITY as a rule — but not here: تَنَاوَلَ means to reach out and take in, and the pattern has drifted from its own headline meaning. A wazn tells you where to look for a sense, not what the sense is.
The maf'ul bihi, in nasb.
«La» denying, and with what follows it stands as a NA'T of «one instance» — an adjectival phrase built out of a negation.

A jarr-majrur, «the very self of» a mudaf and the HA its mudaf ilayh. The sense: ONE of the kind, but no one of them in particular — so any instance discharges the duty. «Free a slave» is unrestricted; any slave will do.

sentences.text: وَالْمُقَيَّدُ مَا تَنَاوَلَ مَوْصُوفًا بِوَصْفٍ زَائِدٍ عَلَى أَصْلِ الْحَقِيقَةِ

translation.en: And the restricted is what takes in something described by a description over and above the bare reality.
translation.tr: Mukayyed, aslî hakikatin üzerine bir vasıfla vasıflanmış olanı kapsayandır.

jumal.text: الْمُقَيَّدُ مَا تَنَاوَلَ مَوْصُوفًا بِوَصْفٍ زَائِدٍ
jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the restricted» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.
A past verb; the clause is the sila. The verb is repeated word for word, so the difference between the two definitions lies wholly in the OBJECT: there وَاحِدًا, here مَوْصُوفًا.

The maf'ul bihi in nasb — the ism maf'ul of وَصَفَ. The verb is a MITHAL, and its waw drops in the mudari (يَصِفُ); in the participle it stands, because there is no kasra behind it to push it out. The same letter, present in one cell and gone from another, and the reason is entirely local.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «described» — the masdar of وَصَفَ. A participle governs like its verb, which is why the phrase hangs on it rather than on anything further back.

A na't of «a description», in jarr — the ism fa'il of زَادَ, an AJWAF YAI. Its middle radical turns into a HAMZA in the participle: زَايِد becomes زَائِد, exactly as قَالَ gives قَائِل and بَاعَ gives بَائِع. This is the third face of ز ي د in this package — اِزْدَادَ carried the ibdal of the ta, and here the same root shows the i'lal of the ayn.
A jarr letter attaching to «over and above».
In jarr after «ala» and a mudaf — and «asl» is the very word the book opened with, in chapter 1. Nine chapters later it is still doing work.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr — and haqiqa is a wording used for what it was set down for. Here what is meant is the bare NATURE of the thing before any description is added: «a slave» is the reality, «a believing slave» is the reality plus a fetter.

sentences.text: وَلَا يُحْمَلُ الْمُطْلَقُ عَلَى الْمُقَيَّدِ عِنْدَنَا إِلَّا بِدَلِيلٍ

translation.en: And the unrestricted is not carried onto the restricted with us, except by an indication.
translation.tr: Bize göre mutlak, bir delil olmadıkça mukayyede hamledilmez.

jumal.text: لَا يُحْمَلُ الْمُطْلَقُ عَلَى الْمُقَيَّدِ إِلَّا بِدَلِيلٍ
jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ مَعْطُوفَةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A joined verbal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw, and «la» simply denying, governing nothing.

A mudari built for the unnamed doer, in raf' — from ح م ل, the root that gave يَحْتَمِلُ on اِفْتِعَال in the chapter on the muhkam. Two babs of one root in one book, and the nakil drill will now show both.
The naib al-fa'il, in raf'.
A jarr letter attaching to «is carried» — and part of its meaning: a thing is carried ONTO something.
In jarr after «ala».

An adverb in nasb and a mudaf, with «na» as its mudaf ilayh — and this is the word by which the matn declares WHOSE position it is stating. «With us» means the Hanafis; others hold otherwise, and the matn does not pretend the question is settled for everyone.
The particle of exception, the exception MUFARRAGH — the third in four chapters. By now the shape should be recognised before the words are read: a negation, an إِلَّا, and no mustathna minhu named.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «is carried» — the emptied exception itself. And «dalil» is the word chapter 2 pluralised in its opening line: الْأَدِلَّةُ أَرْبَعَةٌ. The book has come round to its own first term.

sentences.text: فَإِذَا ثَبَتَ الدَّلِيلُ حُمِلَ الْمُطْلَقُ عَلَى الْمُقَيَّدِ

translation.en: So when the indication is established, the unrestricted is carried onto the restricted.
translation.tr: Delil sâbit olduğunda mutlak, mukayyede hamledilir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ لِـ«إِذَا».
jumal.en: A verbal clause in the position of jarr, the mudaf ilayh of «idha».

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ جَوَابُ الشَّرْطِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the answer of the condition — i'rabless.

human.irab: A «telling» fa, and «idha» an adverb of TIME TO COME carrying the sense of a condition — it is not a pure particle but a zarf with a condition folded into it, which is why the books put it apart from إِنْ.

A past verb, in the position of JARR because «idha» is added to it — it is the condition-verb. «Idha» takes its clause for a mudaf ilayh exactly as حَيْثُ did in the chapter on the mufassar. Two words in one book that are added to whole sentences.
The fa'il, in raf'.

A past verb built for the unnamed doer, and the clause is «idha»'s ANSWER — i'rabless. Note that no fa joins it: the answer of a condition takes a fa only when it could not otherwise stand as an answer, and a plain past verb can.
The naib al-fa'il, in raf'.
A jarr letter attaching to «is carried».
In jarr after «ala» — and the chapter closes on what it opened with: two kinds, and then the ruling for what happens when they meet.

sentences.text: ثُمَّ اللَّفْظُ بِاعْتِبَارِ الِاسْتِعْمَالِ حَقِيقَةٌ وَمَجَازٌ وَصَرِيحٌ وَكِنَايَةٌ

translation.en: Then the wording, taken by its use, is literal, figurative, plain or veiled.
translation.tr: Lafız, kullanımı itibarıyla hakikat, mecâz, sarîh ve kinâyedir.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ اسْتِئْنَافِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: An isti'naf nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A letter of atf giving sequence with an interval.

The mubtada in raf' — the same mubtada that opened the chapter on the divisions and the chapter on clarity. THREE divisions of one and the same thing, each cut by a different ruler: what it was set down for, how plainly it shows, and what it is being used for now.

A jarr-majrur hanging on an omitted hal, and «taken by» a mudaf — the phrase that announces a change of RULER. Every division in this book is introduced by it, and the reader who watches for it never confuses two divisions of the same word.

The mudaf ilayh in jarr — the masdar of اِسْتَعْمَلَ on اِسْتِفْعَال. Between it and الْوَضْع lies the whole distinction this chapter rests on: the SETTING-DOWN came before any speaker, the USE is what a speaker does with what he found.

The khabar in raf' with its tanwin — and حَقِيقَة stood in the chapter before as a mudaf ilayh, borrowed for another definition. Here it is defined for its own sake. A term is used before it is defined and defined when it must be; that is the order a matn keeps.
Joined, in raf' — a mimic masdar from جَازَ: the wording that has stepped past its own place.
Joined, in raf' — on فَعِيل from صَرُحَ: the unmixed, the wording that needs nothing beside it to be understood.

Joined, in raf' — the masdar of كَنَى, and with it the kinds are complete. In balagha the kinaya is a chapter of its own; here it is one of the ways a wording may be used, and the two treatments are the same subject approached from two sciences.

sentences.text: فَالْحَقِيقَةُ مَا اسْتُعْمِلَ فِيمَا وُضِعَ لَهُ

translation.en: So the literal is what has been used in the very thing it was set down for.
translation.tr: Hakikat, kendisi için vaz' edildiği mânâda kullanılandır.

jumal.text: الْحَقِيقَةُ مَا اسْتُعْمِلَ فِيمَا وُضِعَ لَهُ
jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ الثَّانِي — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the second relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A fa joining for detail; «the literal» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb built for the unnamed doer, on اِسْتَفْعَلَ; the clause is the sila. The rule for the passive of a past verb is two vowels and no more: a DAMMA on its first letter and a KASRA before its last. اِسْتَعْمَلَ becomes اسْتُعْمِلَ, and the same two moves turn نَصَرَ into نُصِرَ and اِسْتَخْرَجَ into اسْتُخْرِجَ, however long the word.

«Fi» is a jarr letter and «ma» a relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of jarr after it — ONE word in writing and TWO in i'rab. The fusion is orthographic only, and every rule that reads the ma must peel the jarr off first or it will never see it.

A past verb built for the unnamed doer; the clause is the sila of the SECOND «ma». It is the very verb chapter 4 built its definitions on — «what was set down for one meaning». Here the same verb marks off the meaning a word may now be used in.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «was set down», its HA going back to the second «ma» — the returning pronoun that ties that sila to its own relative. Two relatives in one sentence, each with its own clause and its own tie.

sentences.text: وَالْمَجَازُ مَا اسْتُعْمِلَ فِي غَيْرِ مَا وُضِعَ لَهُ لِعَلَاقَةٍ بَيْنَهُمَا

translation.en: And the figurative is what has been used in other than what it was set down for, for a relation between the two.
translation.tr: Mecâz, aralarındaki bir alâka sebebiyle, vaz' edildiğinin gayrısında kullanılandır.

jumal.text: الْمَجَازُ مَا اسْتُعْمِلَ فِي غَيْرِ مَا وُضِعَ لَهُ
jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the figurative» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb built for the unnamed doer; the clause is the sila. The verb is repeated word for word, and ONE word is inserted: غَيْر. That single insertion is the whole difference between the literal and the figurative.
A jarr letter attaching to «has been used».

In jarr after «fi» and a mudaf — and what is added to it is a whole RELATIVE PHRASE, «what it was set down for». A mudaf ilayh need not be a single noun; a مَا with its sila is one noun as far as the idafa is concerned.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of jarr as the mudaf ilayh.
A past verb built for the unnamed doer; the clause is the sila, i'rabless.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «was set down», the HA the returning pronoun.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «has been used», the LAM giving the reason — and this restriction is what separates a MAJAZ from a MISTAKE. A word may not be carried to another meaning at will: there must be a known relation between the two, and the balagha books count those relations one by one. Calling a brave man a lion is a majaz; calling him a table is an error.

A place-adverb in nasb and a mudaf, with the DUAL pronoun «huma» as its mudaf ilayh — going back to the two meanings: the one the word was set down for and the one it is now used in. The dual is exact: a majaz always has two ends, never one and never three.

sentences.text: وَالصَّرِيحُ مَا ظَهَرَ الْمُرَادُ بِهِ ظُهُورًا بَيِّنًا لِكَثْرَةِ الِاسْتِعْمَالِ

translation.en: And the plain is that whose intended sense shows with an evident showing, from the frequency of its use.
translation.tr: Sarîh, çok kullanılması sebebiyle murâdı apaçık ortaya çıkandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ صِلَةُ الْمَوْصُولِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause, the sila of the relative — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the plain» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb; the clause is the sila. It is the same verb that defined الظَّاهِر in the clarity chapter, but the question is not the same: there the meaning showed by the very hearing of the words, here it shows because the words have been used that way so often. The wording is clear by HABIT, not by nature.
The fa'il, in raf'.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «shows», the HA going back to «that which».

A MAF'UL MUTLAQ in nasb — a masdar from the very verb that governs it, brought so that it can be DESCRIBED. A bare maf'ul mutlaq merely confirms; one carrying an adjective tells you what KIND. This is the second in the package after نَقْلًا مُتَوَاتِرًا in chapter 2, and both are there for the adjective's sake.
A na't of «a showing», in nasb — a sifa mushabbaha on فَيْعِل from بَانَ, its origin بَيْيِن with the two yas run together. It is the adjective the maf'ul mutlaq was brought to carry.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «shows», the LAM giving the reason, and «the frequency of» a mudaf.
The mudaf ilayh in jarr — and with it the chapter returns to the ruler it opened with. Everything in it has been measured by USE, and the plain is plain because of how much it has been used.

sentences.text: وَالْكِنَايَةُ مَا اسْتَتَرَ الْمُرَادُ بِهِ فَلَا يُفْهَمُ إِلَّا بِقَرِينَةٍ

translation.en: And the veiled is that whose intended sense lies hidden, so it is not understood except by an indication.
translation.tr: Kinâye, murâdı gizli kalan ve ancak bir karîneyle anlaşılandır.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A nominal clause — i'rabless.

jumal.ar: جُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ مَعْطُوفَةٌ عَلَى الصِّلَةِ — لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا.
jumal.en: A verbal clause joined to the sila — i'rabless.

human.irab: A joining waw; «the veiled» is the mubtada in raf'.
A relative noun, fixed in form, in the position of raf' as the khabar.

A past verb on اِفْتَعَلَ from س ت ر; the clause is the sila. Of the two tas you see, the SECOND is the pattern's and the first letter is the root's sin — and the pattern's ta stands unchanged, because sin is not among the letters that force the ibdal. Set it beside اِزْدَادَ and اِطَّلَعَ from chapters 5 and 6: three verbs, one pattern, and the first radical decides what becomes of its ta.
The fa'il, in raf'.
A jarr-majrur attaching to «lies hidden», the HA the returning pronoun.
A fa joining in sequence AND in cause — «and so», not merely «and» — with «la» simply denying and governing nothing.

A mudari built for the unnamed doer, in raf' — and the present tense is built for it differently from the past: a DAMMA on its first letter, but a FATHA before its last, where the past takes a kasra. اسْتُعْمِلَ against يُفْهَمُ, in one chapter, is the whole pair.
The particle of exception, the exception MUFARRAGH — the fourth in five chapters. Four negations, four إِلَّا, and no mustathna minhu named in any of them.

A jarr-majrur attaching to «is understood» — the emptied exception itself.
